answer: Reputation decay is a rule under which a score falls 8 points per idle epoch after 2 idle epochs, from 100, with rights lost below 60. Idleness triggers the deduction; only verification tasks restore it, at most 6 points each. Scale sets the cost: 1,000 clones cost 3,000 units per epoch; a missed cycle loses 8,000 points a month. A cipher-bound identity cannot hide idle history; a juniper task refreshes the score; a hoarded summit erodes.
